Instructions

Listen, then put the numbers in order

« Écoutez les nombres et dites dans quel ordre vous les entendez. »

Listen to the numbers and say in which order you hear them.

For every group of four numbers, the audio reads them out in a scrambled order. Your job is to label each printed number with the position it was spoken in — 1st, 2nd, 3rd, or 4th.

Worked example
8777776 you hear → 76,87,7,77
872 73 774 761

87 was the 2nd number spoken, 7 was the 3rd, 77 was the 4th, and 76 was the 1st — so the printed number "87" gets the order-label "2", and so on.

Exercice

Four groups to order

Pick 1, 2, 3, or 4 in each dropdown for the position you hear that number spoken. Check one group at a time, or check everything at once at the bottom.

Score : 0/16
